content.short: SPOT Check is a series of checks and useful tips for Stake Pool Operators to make sure Cardano nodes are working properly.
content.description:
The Cardano SPOT Check has these useful sections that are useful for SPO’s: Basic Checks - regular checks to ensure Cardano nodes are running correctly. Advanced Checks - checks on hidden issues that are not easy to discover and will prevent nodes from producing blocks. Tips - contains tips and tricks to optimize maintenance of Cardano nodes. Troubleshooting - common issues encountered and their solutions This site is created and maintained by WISH Pool with additional content contributed by members of the Cardano Community.
